title: AAPS Wear, latest dev commit#041d0f0: Ongoing bolus notification that can not be cleared.
symptom: On Samsung Watch 4 running AAPS watchface (stock or custom), an ongoing notification appears that cannot be cleared; it immediately reopens after clearing. The issue is specific to bolus notifications, which stay open at 100% - Success.
cause: The ongoing notification channel introduced in commit 041d0f0 is necessary to keep the app running in the background, but it causes an un-clearable notification on the watch. The user concluded that the ongoing channel is unexpected/unwanted behavior only necessary for users running non-AAPS watchfaces.
fix: Partially fixed through PR #3141. For the remaining 'Datalayer Foreground Service Channel' notification, the user suggests switching it off from watch developer options: App Notifications -> All watch apps -> AAPS -> Data layer Foreground Service Channel: OFF.
settings_changed: Data layer Foreground Service Channel → OFF
evidence_quote: Still getting "Datalayer Foreground Service Channel" notification that can't be cleared (Samsung Watch4). **Solution**: Switch off this notification from watch developer options: `App Notifications -> All watch apps -> AAPS -> Data layer Foreground Service Channel: OFF`
